data.name: Nick's Game
data.detailed_description:
Steam-only co-op fantasy action RPG & party game built around roguelike dungeon runs, base building, and cosmetics.

(Nick's Game is a placeholder game title and will be replaced with the real title as soon as we choose a good name based on the lore and gameplay)

Play solo or with up to 3 friends, build a character, go on dungeon runs, defeat enemies & bosses, collect rewards, and return to your base to regroup, train, customize, and prepare for the next game.

Core Gameplay

The main mode is a co-op roguelike dungeon crawler for 1-4 players. A full successful run is planned around three environments, three major bosses, and a clear final victory condition.

Main game mode is a third-person action RPG that is easy to pick up but difficult to master. Enemies and bosses are designed around readable telegraphed attacks, positioning, timing, and team coordination.

Character Builds And Progression

Each dungeon run, choose a starting class and build your character over the course of the run. Adapt your build based on what loot you're receiving. Long term progression is cosmetic-based and skill-based.

Players can experiment with weapon categories, armor classes, and special abilities across runs. The goal is to master your playstyle, improve your runs, and collect cosmetics and base items across sessions.

Social Base Mode

Between runs, players can return to a personal base island with friends. The base is a social and casual mode where players can gather with friends, practice movement and abilities, show off cosmetics, decorate, and play minigames.

Planned Steam Features

Steam features include friends, invites, lobbies, voice chat, rich presence, achievements, stats, Workshop support for creator submissions, and Steam Inventory support for cosmetic items where appropriate.

Steam Workshop support is planned for cosmetic submissions and base items. Official accepted content may become part of curated base-game collections after review.

- 1-4 Player Co-op Roguelike Action RPG Dungeon Runs

- Third-person action combat with party-focused encounters

- Social base-building mode for socializing, decorating, and playing minigames

- Cosmetic-focused progression and skill-based progression built using Steam-native systems

- Workshop-oriented creator pipeline for future community-made cosmetics and base items

- A long-term platform structure designed to support additional modes over time

Future Modes

The game platform is also designed to support future modes such as party-based tactics campaigns, board game style party game, and smaller minigames.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 / Intel Arc or equivalent with Direct3D 12 or Vulkan support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc A580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: CoreAudio-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon only. Intel Macs are not supported.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma or newer
  • Processor: Apple M2 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: CoreAudio-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon only. Intel Macs are not supported.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, SteamOS 3.0, or equivalent 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Steam Deck APU or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 / Steam Deck GPU or equivalent with Vulkan support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio/PipeWire compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan-capable drivers required.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04, SteamOS 3.0, or equivalent 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580 or better with Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio/PipeWire compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD and current GPU drivers recommended.
